name: Mage Armor
description: Level 1 Abjuration (Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: Touch Components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather) Duration: 8 hours You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Agility modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.
